title: AI POD subsystem 05 - UCS management nodes
description: Canonical composed inventory contract for UCS systems assigned to the management tier. A domain is represented by its two CIMC endpoints but becomes one Intersight claim target; that cross-system relationship is validated by the inventory adapter. Model, serial number, product family, installed GPUs, Device ID, and Claim Code are discovered at runtime and never manually duplicated here.

inventory_host.description: Stable Ansible inventory handle. It is generated by the adapter from inventory.yml, not copied as a second editable value into host_vars.

platform.description: UCS management platform. domain represents a paired UCS-X Direct or UCS domain; standalone represents one rack server.

role.description: Subsystem 05 owns UCS systems assigned to the management tier. OpenShift later determines control versus compact.

claim_target.description: Stable target key used to deduplicate a paired domain into one Intersight claim. Standalone systems use their own inventory handle.
